description: NeqSim is a Java library for fluid properties, phase equilibrium and process simulation, maintained by Equinor. Its documented functions include pipeline flow, equipment sizing, reservoir-fluid calculations and field-development analyses. The provider is Equinor; originally developed at NTNU. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository identifies Apache 2.0 and public package distributions. Dependencies may have separate licences. Limitations: The broad model list and industrial-use statements are provider descriptions. This review did not verify numerical models, engineering-standard conformity or example results. For simulation it supports coupled fluid and process calculations for oil, gas, hydrogen and carbon-management systems. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
